name: Courtyard Mosque
summary: A domed hall and square minaret rise from a compact open courtyard, viewed at a gentle angle.
why: The open center gives the mosque a peaceful gathering space. A dome and stepped minaret identify the building while a pair of broad shaded walls creates depth without miniature ornament.
risk: The courtyard is less obvious at 24 pixels, where the angled building, dome, and minaret become the main impression.
reasonToChoose: The mosque should feel like a peaceful place to enter.

palette.name: COURTYARD MOSQUE / DEEP TEAL + IVORY + SAND
